svg.title: Same Fact, Three Readers
svg.desc: One checked survey figure rewritten for three readers: a trustee summary with the decision needed, a volunteer briefing in plain words, and a leaflet line for members, each stating the same figure in different language and length.
svg.text: Change the words and length; never the figure.
62% of members over 75 feel lonely at least weekly (survey of 1,240)
About six in ten members over
same. Ask us about a weekly
Same figure in every version; you edit and own each one
AUDIENCE WITH A DECISION TO MAKE
